title: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
summary: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop IDE (built on CodeOSS) where humans and AI coding agents collaborate on software architecture via a shared canvas. Agents like Claude Code and Codex get an SDK to draw diagrams, traces, and specs linked directly to code. Features include an AST-aware semantic diff viewer in Rust, a decision log for agent reasoning, and LSP support. It targets reviewing agent-generated code and reducing 'cognitive debt' from unreviewed AI contributions.
